extracted.intended_audience: Heads of executive departments and establishments; federal agency managers and budget/management officers
extracted.subtask_description: Transmittal memorandum rescinding the previously required Annual Management Report under OMB Circular No. A-44 (Revised) and clarifying which portions of the Circular remain in effect. Applies to executive departments and agencies and takes effect immediately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rescission of Annual Management Report requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: The requirement for the submission of an Annual Management Report, as prescribed by the Office of Management and Budget Circular No. A-44, Revised, dated May 24, 1972, is rescinded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit rescission: agencies are no longer required to prepare or submit the Annual Management Report previously mandated by A-44 (Revised).

rubrics_metrics.name: Remaining policy portions of Circular remain in effect
rubrics_metrics.description: The remaining portions of the Circular dealing with policy aspects of the Management Improvement Program remain in effect.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Although the Annual Management Report requirement is rescinded, policy guidance within A-44 related to the Management Improvement Program continues to govern agency actions; the program is under review and new policy guidelines will be forthcoming.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicability to departments and agencies
rubrics_metrics.description: This transmittal memorandum applies to all departments and agencies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Directed to the Heads of Executive Departments and Establishments — the instruction is broad and covers all executive branch departments and agencies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Immediate effective date
rubrics_metrics.description: This transmittal memorandum is effective immediately.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The rescission and the statements about which portions remain in effect were approved July 17, 1973, and are to be implemented without delay by the recipient organizations.
